title: Normalized First-Order Methods for Convex (L0, L1)-Smooth Optimization with Inexact Gradients
summary: Generalized smoothness, such as (L0, L1)-smoothness, have recently attracted considerable attention due to their ability to model optimization problems arising in modern machine and deep learning, where the classical Lipschitz assumptions of the gradient is often violated. At the same time, computing exact gradients may be impractical or computationally expensive in many applications.
